{{NameSDV|Yellow Pickles|alt=Jellies and Pickles|alt2=Pickles}} }} '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a vegetable [[Crops|Crop]] that can be grown from [[Gold Carrot Seeds]] in 6 days during {{Season|Spring}}, {{Season|Summer}}, and {{Season|Fall}}. {{PAGENAME}} cannot be placed in a [[Stardew:Seed Maker|Seed Maker]]. {{TOC|limit=2}} ==Summary== {{#lst:Crop Summaries|Gold Carrot}} ==Crop Growth Calendar== {{#lst:Crop Growth Calendars|Gold Carrot}} ==Multi-Seasonal Crop== {{PAGENAME}} may be planted in Spring, Summer, and Fall. There is no difference in its behavior in either season. If a {{PAGENAME}} plant (of any growth stage) is in the ground on the 28th of Spring or Summer, it will continue growing on the 1st of Summer or Fall as though nothing had changed. [[Stardew:Fertilizer|Fertilizer]] in the ground underneath a {{PAGENAME}} plant on Spring or Summer 28 will not disappear on Summer or Fall 1. Fully-grown {{PAGENAME}} plants may be left unharvested until the 1st of Summer or Fall to prevent fertilizer and tilled soil from disappearing. ==Gifting== {{PAGENAME}} is a '''universally liked''' gift. ==Recipes== ===Artisan Goods=== {{CraftingRecipes|header}} |- | [[File:Yellow Juice.png|link=]]||[[Stardew:Juice|Juice]]||{{Description|Juice}}||{{Name|Gold Carrot|1}}||[[Stardew:Keg|Keg]]||{{Duration|6000}}||{{Price|ceil(2.25*1000)}}||{{Price|floor((2.25*1000)*1.4)}} |- | [[File:Yellow Pickles.png|link=]]||[[Stardew:Jellies and Pickles|Pickles]]||{{Description|Pickles}}||{{Name|Gold Carrot|1}}||[[Stardew:Preserves Jar|Preserves Jar]]||{{Duration|4000}}||{{Price|ceil((2*1000)+50)}}||{{Price|floor(((2*1000)+50)*1.4)}} {{CraftingRecipes|footer}} ==Bundles== {{PAGENAME}} is not used in any bundles. ==Quests== {{PAGENAME}} is not used in any quests. ==Tailoring== {{DyePot|gold}} When used in dyeing, {{PAGENAME}} produces a gold color. ==History==
